variable_coverage.construction: Quarterly buy-and-hold CRSP security return over the fullret window (two days after prior quarterly earnings announcement through the day after current announcement), minus the CRSP value-weighted market return over the corresponding interval; pooled across all 20 post-formation quarters.

Growth portfolio is the 0–4 quarterly MB quintile formed at quarter t from quarter-end market value of shares divided by quarter-end common equity; exact cross-sectional population for breakpoints remains unresolved.
Indicator equal to 1 when realized quarterly EPS exceeds the corresponding median I/B/E/S forecast in the follow-up quarter; zero otherwise.
Indicator equal to 1 when realized quarterly EPS is below its corresponding median I/B/E/S forecast in the follow-up quarter; zero otherwise.
Product of baseline formation-quarter Growth quintile and follow-up Good-news indicator.
Product of baseline formation-quarter Growth quintile and follow-up Bad-news indicator.

design_coverage.reason: Dependence is handled by the paper’s repeat-count t/F-statistic adjustment, not by a reported cluster-robust variance estimator.
Estimator is not named; source states regression analysis and gives a repeat-count adjustment for t/F statistics.
The Table 3 equation reports an intercept, growth, good/bad indicators and two interactions; no fixed effects are reported.
No regression weights are reported for Table 3.

implementation_issues.description: The article describes regression analysis but does not identify the underlying estimator for Table 3 all-20-quarter model.

The exact sample pool used for the annual/quarterly MB quintile cutpoints and the 1% FE winsorization tails is not fully identified across the 139,027 initial and 103,274 final pools. Preserve the two populations separately.
The paper explicitly scales forecast errors with I/B/E/S price at the final month of the fiscal quarter; no local I/B/E/S price field was verified. CRSP PRC is not a source-equivalent substitute.

PDF inspection of physical pages 16–17 resolves the five-year t-statistic adjustment: divide by the square root of the maximum repeat count (sqrt(20)); the F statistic adjustment is divided by 20. The OCR/reading text had separated the root across pages, so this clarification is retained.

review_notes: Retained the Table 3 all-20-quarters specification (N=1,386,813 follow-up observations) and its equation-specific CRSP value-weighted market-index definition. The more general size-matched portfolio discussion is not used for this fit. The PDF was visually inspected on physical pages 16–17; the t-stat adjustment is sqrt(20), and F-stat adjustment is 20. Initial I/B/E/S pool (139,027) is kept distinct from post-Compustat/CRSP formation sample (103,274).
The selected Table 3 model uses Good/Bad signs; FE magnitude winsorization from the unselected Table 4 specification is not a required input for this fit.
